_readme: Copy this file to admob.local.json (ignored by Git) and replace every
placeholder with the exact value from the AdMob console.
The four mobile identifiers belong to the Indigen World Android app
(package com.indigenworld.indigen); each placement needs its own Native
advanced unit. ADMOB_APP_ADS_TXT_RECORD is the authorised-seller line the
website publishes at /app-ads.txt, copied exactly, and is only needed by
Never commit the filled-in file or paste a value into a tracked file.
Debug and staging builds always use Google's published sample ids instead;
CI reads the same keys from repository secrets of the same names.
